title: A project's own Claude Code deny/ask rules (.harness/project/deny-rules.json)
description: B-106: rules a project adds to permissions.deny / permissions.ask of every Claude Code settings file the bundle merges (.claude/settings.json, .claude/settings.posix.json). Project-owned: bundle installs never ship or overwrite .harness/project/, and the installer adds these rules on every install, so they cannot be lost the way hand-added rules in settings.json were. Can only NARROW: there is no allow list, and an entry without rule + reason is ignored and named. Written by the owner (AI writes are blocked by self-protect-paths.json). Local Claude Code rules are defense-in-depth, not a boundary (C10).

rule.description: A Claude Code rule, e.g. Bash(ssh:*)

reason.description: Why, e.g. the review item it implements (BM-02)
